name: Sonic.exe Plus!
summary:
Uncover the haunting sins of the past update-by-update in this Sonic.exe fan game.

As the father of a deceased son, you, Edward Mislik, must play through your sons old Sonic the Hedgehog game cardrige, only to find things aren't the same as they used to be. The characters are different. They look twisted and multilated, their faces unchanging, and in cutscenes they look 3D. They act without input, almost seeming alive... They speak of things they should have no knowledge of... Sonic himself seems espechally knowing, as if you're best buddies... Will you find the way to save them, or will you join them? Your choice...
